text:
London gets much more rain than hot or dry cities such as Cairo (about 25 mm a year), Dubai and Riyadh (about 100 mm each), Las Vegas (about 120 mm), Phoenix (about 200 mm), Los Angeles (about 370 mm), and Madrid (about 440 mm), against roughly 600 mm for London. The shared note is wrong about New York and Chicago, which get roughly 1,200 mm and 900 mm a year, well above London, while Paris (about 650 mm) is roughly comparable. These are approximate long-term averages from memory, not checked against a live source.

CONFIDENCE: 80
